turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to save for a holiday next summer and I have a few plans in mind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is to save a fixed amount from every paycheck into a separate holiday pot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the round up thing, where the app rounds up every purchase and saves the change.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could pick up extra shifts at the cafe on weekends just for the holiday money.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How far off is the holiday? If it's a while, the fixed transfer plus round ups on top is easy and steady. Save the extra shifts in case you fall behind.
